# Stack
A classic skill and timing game for Flipper Zero. Precision is key as you stack moving blocks layer by layer.

## Features

- Addictive tower-building gameplay driven by precise timing
- Smooth animation optimized for the Flipper Zero display
- On-screen score tracker to push your personal high scores
- The gaming experience has been enhanced with vibration, dynamic sound effects, and LED lighting during gameplay

## Controls

- OK: Drop the moving block onto the stack
- BACK: Exit the application
- Up / Down: Navigate through the menu options
